asked.item: status-check loop getting 429s and workflow stops

verdict.reason: The rate limits page gives general handling steps for 429 responses, including polling with intervals, and these apply whichever status route the loop calls.

steps.text: After a 429, stop requests to the limited route.
Wait for the retry interval when the response supplies one.
Reduce concurrency and request frequency before resuming.
Use polling intervals rather than repeated status calls without a delay.
